articleTitle: Research on an improved algorithm of Apriori based on Hadoop
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the development of mobile Internet, association rules data mining is still a research hotspot. In this paper, the traditional mining algorithm of association rules for Apriori is analyzed, which has low efficiency and poor expansibility, because it scans the database many times and produces a large number of redundant frequent itemsets when dealing with big data. Therefore, it is proposed that the Apriori algorithm is improved by using the MapReduce model of Hadoop platform to parallelize processing, and the experimental results show that the improved Apriori algorithm has high efficiency and good stability in big data processing, it has great potential to excavate. Finally, the algorithm is applied to the data mining of student scores, which verifies its effectiveness and can provide services for education management.

articleTitle: Research on the Improved Word2Vec Optimization Strategy Based on Statistical Language Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to improve the text matching degree and calculation accuracy of the short text classification method, this paper studies the optimization of the short text classification method of the Word2Vec algorithm. First of all, in order to solve the problem of insufficient features extracted by traditional text sign extraction methods, this paper constructs the feature vector space of the text through the word vector model of distributed semantic expression. Secondly, it uses the Word2Vec algorithm to train the word vector database, and extracts the feature vectors in this paper through the statistical language model. At last, it verifies the reliability and practicability of the algorithm proposed in this paper through empirical analysis. The research results show that the word vector semantic model based on distributed semantic expression can establish the feature vector space of short texts, reducing the probability of gradient explosion. The use of statistical language models can calculate the feature vector of each word combination in the short text. Thus, the feature vector value based on the word sequence is obtained. The Word2Vec algorithm improved by the empirical analysis model has a good classification effect on short text, which proves the effectiveness of the method of this research. This study proved that the Word2Vec algorithm can be optimized by using the statistical language model to improve the text matching degree and calculation accuracy of the text classification algorithm.

articleTitle: A Safe and Efficient Message Authentication Scheme In The Internet Of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to realize the security authentication of information transmission between vehicle nodes in the vehicular ad hoc network, based on the certificateless public key cryptosystem and aggregate signature, a privacy-protected certificateless aggregate signature scheme is proposed, which eliminates the complicated certificate maintenance cost. This solution also solves the key escrow problem. By Communicating with surrounding nodes through the pseudonym of the vehicle, the privacy protection of vehicle users is realized. The signature scheme satisfies the unforgeability of an adaptive selective message attack under a random prophetic machine. The scheme meets message authentication, identity privacy protection, resistance to reply attacks.

articleTitle: Method research on ship detection in remote sensing image based on Yolo algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Small target recognition is a classic challenge in the field of target recognition. In this paper, an improved algorithm based on Yolo V3 is proposed for ship detection in remote sensing images. In order to solve the problem that the input satellite image size is too large, the window sliding segmentation technology is used to cut the large image into several small images; because the detection target only has a single kind of ship, K-means algorithm is used to re cluster anchor Box, to improve the detection accuracy of the algorithm; in view of the small ship target in the ocean background, the multi-level feature extraction method is used to highlight the feature vector of small target to improve the recognition ability of small target. Through the above-mentioned methods, using the data set of Airbus ship detection provided by kaggle, the ship target detection has achieved a better comprehensive accuracy rate, which is higher than the accuracy and recall rate of similar target detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Simulated Annealing Genetic Algorithm in Task Assignment of Swarm of Drones
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model is established based on the characteristics of the task assignment of the swarm of drones. The simulated annealing algorithm is introduced into the genetic algorithm of multiple groups. The improved genetic algorithm is applied to solve the mathematical model established in drones assignment task. Experiments result show that the task allocation calculation time base on the simulated annealing algorithm is significantly reduced compared with the standard genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: The Research of Implementation Method of Canny Edge Detection of Video on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Edge detection algorithm has an important application in video image processing. The algorithm overcomes the shortcomings of traditional video image edge detection methods, and significantly improves the quality of video image edge detection. However, the amount of calculation is very large, and the traditional implementation method is difficult to meet the real-time requirements of video image edge detection, and the implementation cost is high. In this design, field programmable gate array (FPGA) is used as the core to construct and implement Canny video image edge detection system. Firstly, the video image is collected by ov7725 camera in real time; then, the edge detection of video image based on Canny algorithm is implemented in FPGA. Finally, the effect of Canny video image edge detection is compared and analyzed. This design has a good reference value for canny video image edge detection.

articleTitle: Research on Passive Detection and Location by Fixed Single Observer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The fixed single station can realize the passive location of the moving target by measuring the angle, angular velocity and Doppler frequency change rate, but this method requires high angular velocity measurement accuracy. For this reason, a fixed mono-station passive detection and location method based on space-frequency domain information is proposed, which uses direction of arrival, phase difference rate-of-change, carrier frequency and Doppler frequency rate-of change to realize passive location of moving targets. The analysis and simulation show that this method avoids the high precision measurement of diagonal velocity, reduces the requirement of parameter measurement technology, and the ranging error is less affected by angle and frequency measurement error. It is greatly affected by the measurement error of phase difference rate-of-change and Doppler frequency rate-of-change.

articleTitle: Target detection in sonar image based on faster RCNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the limitation of underwater target detection method, a detection method based on Faster RCNN is proposed. Using a variety of convolution neural networks to extract image features, constructing a region recommendation network (RPN) to extract the region that may contain the target, and then using the detection network to determine the target area. The application of transfer learning method to ensure that the limited amount of data can also be trained and achieve good results. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of the proposed method in underwater target detection task can be improved by about 14% compared with the basic RCNN method and about 18% higher than the more new YOLO method.

articleTitle: Target height measurement method based on stereo vision
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The key to using binocular stereo vision technology to achieve target height measurement is to obtain accurate predicted box of target. We propose a disparity-method and an edge-method to correct the original predicted box of the target. The main idea of the disparity-method is to use the disparity discontinuity between the target area and the background to find the location of the highest point of the object, so as to correct the upper edge of the original predicted box. The main idea of the edge-method is to find the boundary between the target and the ground based on the edge map, so as to correct the lower side of the original predicted box. It can be seen from the experiment that the corrected predicted box has higher accuracy than the original predicted box obtained by Yolo. Finally, we give a specific method for measuring the height of the object based on binocular stereo vision.

articleTitle: Research on MR virtual scene location method based on image recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of accurate positioning of mixed reality virtual scene in physical space, this paper, firstly, analyzes the positioning principle of mixed reality virtual scene. Secondly, based on the comparison among the three developer kits: ARToolKit, ARTag, and Vuforia and two image optimization algorithms: AHE and ACE, it makes sure to use Vuforia development tool to complete the signature-based tracking and registration task, and use ACE algorithm to optimize the signature-based image. It improves the efficiency, stability and accuracy of image recognition registration. Then the multi-target recognition and registration technology is used to realize the multi-location of virtual scene. Finally, Hololens glasses are used as the hardware carrier to verify the above method. The experimental results show that the above method not only realizes the precise location of MR virtual scene based on image recognition, but also ensures the absolute position of the virtual model in the real space, bringing users a more real virtual experience. Keywords-mixed reality, multi-person collaboration, virtual positioning, gesture interaction.

articleTitle: Design of Electric Power Enterprise Information Database Based on Data Mining and ERP Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the field of power engineering, in order to promote the integration of various types of information resources, the demand for power enterprise information database platforms is increasing. The power enterprise information automation system can guarantee the reliability of the power system operation and the security of the power grid system. During the operation, it can make the work of employees more convenient. This paper proposes a model of power enterprise information database construction based on data mining and ERP technology to form a standardized collection of basic information for power enterprises. By using data mining technology, the information needed can be searched from a large amount of data information. The application of data mining technology in the information automation control system of power enterprise is of great significance, which promotes the development and innovation of power enterprise and improves the economic benefits of power enterprise.

articleTitle: Summary of Research on Satellite Cooperative Transmission Technology in Space Information Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the increasing demand for high-speed transmission of space information, space communication networks based on satellite cooperation are widely used in ocean communications, emergency rescue, spacecraft tracking, and deep space exploration. Aiming at the characteristics of complex network structure, dynamic topology, unstable transmission quality, and the resulting transmission time extension, high bit error rate, poor connectivity, etc., the satellite-based system is analyzed from three aspects: network architecture, collaboration strategy, and working frequency. Cooperative space information transmission technology has been researched and prospected. From the perspective of network architecture, the future space communication network is gradually moving toward a multilayer three-dimensional network, and the structure will evolve to a more flexible spatial self-organizing mesh network structure; from the perspective of network components, there are inter-satellite links and on-board Cooperative satellites with processing functions will increasingly become the most basic and important component of future space communication networks. At the same time, by analyzing different collaboration strategies and working frequency bands, it can be seen that adaptive transmission of spatial information based on high frequency bands and cross-layer joint optimization will become the main means to ensure reliable and effective transmission of spatial information, and it will also realize the integration of space, space and ground in the future. An important technical approach for intelligent communication.

articleTitle: The encapsulation technology of CPS node sensor based on UM-BUS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Uniform Model Bus (UM-BUS) is a dynamically reconfigurable high-speed BUS with address reading and writing access to the internal functional units of Cyber-Physical System (CPS) nodes. It can connect multiple CPS nodes and realize resource scheduling and method implementation by master node. There are many types and forms of sensor function methods in CPS node. In order to eliminate the operation difference of method call and make the operation equipment more convenient for users, this paper designed the packaging scheme of sensor method. It uses UM-BUS to implement layer upon layer calls between methods and can operate sensor devices without knowing the internal mechanism of CPS nodes. The simulation platform was built under Linux system for testing, and the experimental results show that the scheme can complete the optimization and encapsulation of functional methods.

articleTitle: Arc Array Radar IAA-STAP Algorithm Based on Sparse Constraint
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The radar with arc antenna array has the advantages of all-orientation space scanning, simultaneous estimation of pitch-azimuth angle and good antenna pattern. However, due to the special geometry of the antenna, the snapshots from different range cells are not independently and identically distributed (IID) samples, resulting in performance degradation in space-time adaptive processing (STAP). In this paper, the model of airborne radar with arc antenna array is established. The improved arc array-based iterative adaptive approach (IAA) algorithm is studied. The IAA algorithm is utilized to estimate the space-time spectrum. The sparse constraint method is used to reduce the clutter ridge width and improve the ability of suppressing clutter and detecting targets. Simulation experiments verify the effectiveness of the IAA algorithm in arc array radar.

articleTitle: Study on collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on prediction for item rating
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As the Internet is developing rapidly and people are becoming increasingly dependent on e-commerce, whether the users can be provided with accurate recommendation information has become the key to attracting users. Under this background, corresponding personalized recommendation systems have been proposed, and collaborative filtering algorithm is one of the algorithms commonly used in the recommendation systems. Collaborative filtering recommends the information in which the user is interested through analyzing the preferences of a group with similar interests and common experience. With the increasing number of users and items in the e-commerce system, the collaborative filtering algorithm is limited by data sparsity in operation, which will influence the quality of the recommendation results. This paper studied the collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on the prediction for item rating, and enhanced the accuracy of the recommendation algorithm by designing an improved similarity-based algorithm for predicting ratings based on the Pearson correlation coefficient.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Generation Method of Virtual Reality Scene and Design of User Experience Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous development of new technology, large-scale virtual reality scene is widely used in various projects, and virtual reality scene directly affects the running speed and real-time update status, and is also one of the key indicators to determine the user experience. Therefore, in view of the above problems, this paper proposes a crowdsourcing number based on the generation confrontation network model from the design of virtual reality scene according to the driven virtual reality scene automatic generation method, the real scene with human-computer interaction ability is generated to meet the design requirements. By comparing the real model, the real-time rendering model on the computer and the virtual model under the virtual reality system, this paper explores the difference of the evaluation of the design scheme by different prototype modes, and studies the cognitive differences and experience differences of the users. The experimental results show that the virtual reality evaluation is very close to the real effect in the experience, and the user experience has a certain degree of impact on the scene characters' vision, using behavior and impression provide more reliable evaluation methods, and provide new ideas for creating a scientific and comprehensive virtual reality design evaluation system.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Dormitory Management System based on SSM framework
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Juding from the current situation, most of the dormitory management in Chinese colleges and universities is in the traditional manual processing mode, the cumbersome process greatly slows down the work speed of managers and discourages most of the students who intend to put forward their demands. Facing the low informatization of college dormitories, we analyze the feasibility and functional requirements of the student dormitory management system, and design a student dormitory management system using Java, SSM framework and MySQL database technology. The system is convenient for scientific and effective management of student dormitories, and it is easy to operate and practical for the management personnel. The Dormitory Management System (DMS) can realize the informatization of dormitory management.

articleTitle: A Prediction Model for Local Scour Depth around Piers Based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: A prediction model for the local scouring depth at bridge piers is built using convolutional neural network (CNN). Measured data which is collected from laboratory tests and field observation is used to train the predicting model which is verified by the measured data of Hangzhou Bay Bridge. The result shows that the predicted value of the local scouring depth at piers obtained by the machine learning model is in good agreement with the measured ones, which is more suitable than existing general formula. The machine learning method is effective in predicting the local scour depth at bridge piers.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Learning of Visual Odometry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Monocular visual odometry (VO) based on deep learning methods is one of the most important research tasks in computer vision in recent decades. Unlike unsupervised and supervised methods, Self-supervised learning can add additional image information to improve the accuracy and robustness of the model without real labels, so the self-supervised visual odometry methods have received widespread attention. However, most self-supervised VO methods do not make full use of self-supervised signals, especially optical flow as a self-supervised signal. In this paper, we make full use of optical flow as a self-supervised signal, a new self-supervised network structure is proposed. This self-supervised network structure adds optical flow as a self-supervised signal to the basic cascaded VO estimation network. While providing additional information to train the camera pose estimation, the optical flow is used to generate mask to solve the occlusion problems that often occur in self-supervised models. We evaluated the self-supervised visual odometry model proposed in this paper on the KITTI dataset. Experiments show that our method has achieved good performance in depth estimation and camera pose estimation.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition based on DCNN BiGRU Self-attention Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In speech emotion recognition, the features extracted by handmade design are generally low-level, they may not be enough to distinguish subjective emotions, and speech signals are usually have time sequence and every frame signal has a different role. Therefore, this paper aims at the above problems, a DCNN BiGRU self-attention model is proposed. The model combines the spatial characteristics of convolutional neural networks, the advantages of circulating neural network in learning time series data, and the characteristics of attention mechanisms that can learn feature weights, thereby improving the accuracy of speech emotion recognition. This model achieved an average recognition rate of 89.53% and 91.74% in the EMO-DB and CASIA databases, and through comparison with other literatures, it is proved that this model can obtain more ideal results in speech emotion recognition.

articleTitle: Application and research of short-term Power load forecasting based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous development of the power industry, the number and types of power data became more and more large. As an important part of power grid planning, the improvement of the accuracy of short-term power load forecasting is of great significance for the reliable and efficient operation of the system. According to the nonlinear characteristics of short-term load forecasting, a forecasting method based on long-term memory neural network (LSTM) is proposed. Through the construction of LSTM model, the actual power load data of a city in China is selected for experiment, and the final results were obtained. Compared with the experimental results of Elman, BP and LSSVM, it is proved that LSTM has better prediction accuracy and smaller error, which proves the validity and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Study on forecasting method of hydrological time series
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the linear and nonlinear characteristics of hydrological time series, a fruit fly optimization algorithm (SOFOA) is proposed by selecting LSTM neural network. Combined with SOFOA-LSTM model, a hydrological prediction model is proposed. The hydrological data are divided according to the time range of flood season and non flood season, and the SOFOA-LSTM model and ARIMA model are combined to realize the complementary advantages of SOFOA-LSTM model and ARIMA model. The nonlinear and linear laws of hydrological data in different periods are mined by SOFOALSTM and ARIMA respectively, and the prediction value of SOFOA-LSTM model is modified by residual prediction of ARIMA model. The experimental results show that the combination of models can make the prediction effect better.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Smart Home Security System Based on AWS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the popularization and application of Internet of Things technology, the degree of intelligence of the home system is getting higher and higher. As an important part of the smart home, the security system plays an important role in protecting against accidents such as flammable gas leakage, fire, and burglary that may occur in the home environment. This design focuses on sensor signal acquisition and processing, wireless access, and cloud applications, and integrates Cypress's new generation of PSoC 6 MCU, CYW4343W Wi-Fi and Bluetooth dual-module chips, and Amazon's AWS cloud into smart home security System designing. First, through the designed air conditioning and refrigeration module, fire warning processing module, lighting control module, ventilation fan control module, combustible gas and smoke detection and warning module, important parameter information in the home environment is obtained. Then, the hardware system is connected to the AWS cloud platform through Wi-Fi; finally, a WEB interface is built in the AWS cloud to realize remote monitoring of the smart home environment. This design has a good reference for the design of future smart home security systems.

articleTitle: A new terrain classification algorithm based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of existing terrain classification methods, this paper proposes a new terrain classification algorithm based on convolutional neural networks. First, the SegNet and SLIC superpixel segmentation methods are combined to solve the boundary blur problem in the terrain classification of the SegNet convolutional neural network. Then, through comparison experiments of irregular and complex terrain classification based on support vector machine, SegNet and SLIC-SegNet, the superiority of the new SLIC-SegNet terrain classification method is verified.

articleTitle: Dynamic Graph Generative Adversarial Networks for Skeleton-Based Human Motion Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Human 3D skeleton contains important dynamic information. By learning human skeleton data, graph neural networks have achieved excellent performance in extracting motion features. And the effectiveness of generative adversarial networks in synthetic data generation attracts much interest. In this work, we propose a novel dynamic graph generative adversarial networks for skeleton-based motion prediction. Our model, which is called DG-GAN, consists of generator and discriminator networks. The generator networks use a traditional encoder-decoder architecture. The encoder uses dynamic graph structures with global spatiotemporal receptive fields to encode human skeleton sequences, and the decoder consists of a sequence of graph-based gate recurrent units to generate prediction. In addition, we train the discriminator networks to calculate the errors between the prediction and the ground truth, and propagate the errors back to improve the quality of prediction. On the Human 3. 6M dataset, DG-GAN achieves competitive performance compared to the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Design Of TT&C Resource Automatic Scheduling Interface Middleware With High Concurrency and Security
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to significantly improve the reliable interaction and fast processing when TT&C(Tracking, Telemetry and Command) Resource Scheduling and Management System (TRSMS) communicate with external systems which are diverse, multiple directional and high concurrent, this paper designs and implements a highly concurrent and secure middleware for TT&C Resource Automatic Scheduling Interface (TRASI). The middleware designs memory pool, data pool, thread pool and task pool to improve the efficiency of concurrent processing, uses the rule dictionary, communication handshake and wait retransmission mechanism to ensure the data interaction security and reliability. This middleware can effectively meet the requirements of TRASI for data exchange with external users and system, significantly improve the data processing speed and efficiency, and promote the information technology and automation level of Aerospace TT&C Network Management Center (TNMC).

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation for Cascading Failure with Critical State: a NetLogo Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With developments of complex systems, researches of cascading failures play a crucial role in many complex networks to enhance cybersecurity. In this paper, a model of cascading failures based on critical states of nodes is proposed. The time factor of handling failure in cascading failures is presented, and the definition of the intensity for malfunction nodes related to initial betweenness. Simulations for scale-free networks using NetLogo under diverse scenarios are given. Results show that deliberate attacks do more harm to the network compared to random attacks. And the ability of nodes to handle faults is important for reducing the spreading of cascading failures.

articleTitle: Micro-Doppler Period Estimation of Ballistic Targets Based on Circular Average Magnitude Difference Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Radar micro-Doppler (m-D) is a prominent feature of ballistic targets, which provides an important means for warhead recognition. However, when the micro-motion of ballistic targets is accompanied by macro-motion, the periodicity of time-frequency representation (TFR) will be disturbed, so it may be difficult to extract m-D features from TFR. In this paper, the circular average magnitude difference (CAMD) coefficients of TFR are used to estimate the precession period of ballistic targets with macro-motion. The simulation is carried out without and with macro-motion, and the results verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Video Classification Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: It takes a large amount of time for artificial video classification and analysis, and the processing efficiency is low, so it is difficult to better meet the practical needs for the era of big data. Therefore, it is extremely urgent to form an intelligent video analysis and classification method, which is worth exploring. In this paper, experiments on feature extraction, feature fusion and similarity measurement are carried out to determine methods to improve video classification accuracy. The results show that the classification accuracy decreases with the increase of pyramid layers. The performance of the cascade SRU method is better, which can improve the classification accuracy. In addition, two-level cascading coding can better complete the extraction of effective information in depth characteristics and promote the accuracy of classification. The classification accuracy of the network increases, after the characteristic aggregation is accomplished by means of average pooling.

articleTitle: Application of VAR Model based on Distributed Least Squares Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper attempts to apply the distributed least squares (DLSA) algorithm which is used to solve the regression problem in the VAR model of the distributed system. By estimating a series of local prediction values of each sub-node, and then weighting it, an effective global prediction value can be obtained. At the same time, this method only requires each sub-node to perform data in association with the main node once, and does not require complex iterations, thus the prediction efficiency of the sample is greatly improved. We first use a LASSO model to select variables to reduce the sample dimension, and this method can be easily and efficiently implemented on the master node through the LARS algorithm. Then we compare the accuracy of the VAR model distributed algorithm with the global VAR model and the AR model. Based on the macroeconomic data set, it can be preliminaries concluded that the distributed algorithm can avoid the influence of some unresolved noise among the highly correlated variables on the prediction results, under the premise that more efficient calculation.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Task Allocation of Loitering Munition Swarm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the continuous development of unmanned systems swarm technology, the loitering munition swarm technology has gained wide attention from various countries for its unique combat advantages, and the task allocation technology is the key guarantee for its completion of combat missions. With regard to this technology, the first and second part of this article introduced the current development, the classification standards and system architecture of task allocation. The third part analyzed the typical distinctions between loitering munition swarm and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) swarm, conducted multiconstraint analysis, summed up the dynamic burst states, established the modeling of distributed task allocation and the performance evaluation function, and also summarized the advantages and disadvantages of typical algorithms. The fourth part prospected the development direction and research focus, and the last part is the conclusion.

articleTitle: A novel D-band sub-harmonic I/Q modulator based on diodes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Based on the GaAs Schottky diodes, a second-harmonic modulator working in D-band is designed to implement I/Q modulation of RF and IF signals. The traces' length of the circuit structure is used to control the signal flow to achieve the mixing in a wide band. Its results show that when the 70 GHz signal is used as the local oscillator signal source, the frequency conversion loss of the RF signals during 130 GHz to140 GHz and 140 GHz to 150 GHz is less than 15 dB, and the minimum conversion loss is better than 11 dB. Meanwhile, the 1 dB compression power is greater than 12 dB and the image rejection ratio outdo 15 dB. Compared with D-band GaAs pHEMT mixers, the designed modulator is featured by simple process, easy implementation, wide-band matching, and high mirroring at low conversion loss.

articleTitle: Joint Optimization for Multi-antenna Relaying Systems Based on Rate Maximization and Antenna Selection Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: To improve the transmission rate of multi-antenna relaying systems, a joint optimization algorithm based on rate maximization and antenna selection is proposed. In order to deal with the coupled amplifying-and-forwarding factors and antenna selection sequence, this joint optimization problem is handled by separating the two variables, and its analytical solution is derived according to optimization theorem. Simulation results show that, the proposed algorithm significantly outperforms the conventional methods in terms of system data rate.

articleTitle: Research on Network Personalized Learning Recommendation Algorithm Based on Knowledge Representation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Since 2000, education reform has quietly risen. As one of the research hotspots of education reform, individualized learning has been valued by various countries. The emergence of the online learning space provides a huge technical environment support for personalized learning. However, how to recommend personalized learning content for learners from the numerous resources on the Internet has always been one of the difficulties in personalized online learning. Technology is a key element for achieving personalized online learning. At present, there are fewer systematic researches and practical applications that combine personalized learning with online learning space. In order to better realize the personalized learning of students and make the personalized learning develop to a higher level, this paper studies the personalized recommendation. The research of personalized recommendation system is an important breakthrough in the realization of information filtering. It is usually based on the user's historical interaction information to mine potential interests and preferences to push items that satisfy users. In this paper, the knowledge representation learning method is used to retain the semantic information of the user or the item itself, and the data is embedded in the low-dimensional vector space to calculate the semantic similarity to generate the recommendation result. This algorithm enriches the semantic information of users or items in traditional recommendation algorithms, effectively enhances the recommendation performance, and makes better recommendations for network personalized learning.

articleTitle: Simulation Experiment of Scheduling Algorithm in Dynamic Heterogeneous Redundancy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Mimic defense is a new type of defense method, and its unpredictability is applicable to the field of network security. This article first introduces several common dynamic scheduling algorithms for heterogeneous executions in mimic defense, and then conducts simulation experiments on the effects of different dynamic scheduling strategies in two attack load loading modes. Experimental results show that in different attack modes, the optimal dynamic scheduling algorithm is different, so defense pertinence and defense randomness need to be emphasized according to the situation.

articleTitle: Exploration of Mapper-A Method for Topological Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The paper introduced the theory of mapper method for data with high dimension to capture topology and geometric information. By using Mapper TDA for magnetic resonance data processing, the paper also learns about a new method based on literature review to detect global time allocation of whole brain activation maps for constructing brain networks. In conclusion, mapper TDA is quite practical and potential for various fields of studies especially for data sets that need to be lower dimension and clustered.

articleTitle: Improved genetic algorithm based on K-Means to solve path planning problem
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper regarded the path planning problem as a TSP problem, and an improved genetic algorithm based on K-Means was proposed. The algorithm firstly decomposes the large-scale TSP problem into multiple small TSP problems through K-Means clustering, and then optimizes each cluster separately using the improved genetic algorithm, and finally merges all clusters to obtain the final route. Experiments show that compared with the standard genetic algorithm, the improved algorithm avoids the solution falling into the local optimal solution and accelerates the convergence of the algorithm. Therefore, this algorithm can save cost and improve efficiency when applied to path planning.

articleTitle: An Equipment Cloud Service Storage Scheme Based on Domain Division in Cloud Manufacturing Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of cloud service selection in the cloud manufacturing environment, an equipment cloud service storage scheme based on domain division is proposed. Has built an equipment cloud service storage model based on domain division, which divides the storage space into several storage areas according to industry domain, location domain and type domain. Different equipment cloud service is stored in different regions according to different domains. This method uses the index table to quickly locate the search area to narrow the search range and improve the search efficiency. This article proposes a storage solution for equipment cloud service based on Hadoop. HDFS and HBase are used for storing unstructured data and structured data, respectively. This solution satisfied the storage requirements of massive dynamic information of the equipment cloud service.

articleTitle: MPE model: a method for the ideal parameters selection based on multiple regression in YHGSM
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In the Yin-he Global Spectral Model (YHGSM) developed by the National University of Defense Technology, an issue to be studied is that how to determine the parameters and achieve the ideal execution time in the model. Based on the multiple regression analysis, we firstly construct a quantitative relationship between the parameters and the execution time in the model by giving a set of random parameters and its execution time in advance. Then we establish the multiple regression equation between them. In this way, we finally establish the model parameter evaluation (MPE) model. In the new model, by giving more random parameters, we can predict their corresponding execution time. On this basis, given a critical value at which the execution time may be accepted, when the execution time is less than the critical value and the model can be operated normally, the determined parameters at this time are the ideal parameters that we recognize.

articleTitle: A Time-efficient and High-performance FPGA-based Continuous Floating-point Matrix Computing Accelerating Architecture for Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Matrix computing is one of the most important linear algebra modes that is broadly used in both scientific and engineering applications. Currently, there is still a lot of space for the optimization of continuous matrix computing accelerating. In this study, we first present two memory access optimization schemes which significantly minimize the I/O time and the total delay. Then, we extend the data accuracy of continuous matrix computing from double-precision to single-precision and half-precision floating-point data, which can enhance data diversity and improve computing performance. The experiments show that the I/O time is reduced by 40% after coarse-grained parallel optimization. Moreover, the I/O time is almost completely hidden by the calculation time after fine-grained data flow optimization. The accelerator achieves a maximum frequency of180 Mhz with 128 PEs and performs 184.3 GFLOPS for half-precision floating-point data. Our design is more outstanding in time-efficient and application scope comparing with state-of-the-art FPGA-based structures.

articleTitle: Research and application of server security protection based on virtual patch
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to accelerate the transformation of energy and power and accelerate the informatization construction of the company, the number of business information systems of the company is increasing day by day, and the influence range of security events is becoming larger and larger, and the security protection of information system and network system becomes more complex and difficult. The traditional patch repair process takes a long time and has high professional requirements. It is easy to cause system compatibility problems and consumes more manpower, material resources and time. The virtual patch technology can provide vulnerability protection in time on the premise of ensuring the normal operation of business system, shorten the time required for testing and deploying key patches, eliminate the key vulnerabilities in servers and desktops, solve the problems of complexity and stability in the process of implementing patches in operational business application systems, and effectively block hacker and malicious code attacks.

articleTitle: An Event-driven Adaptive Strategy for Manufacturing Cloud Services
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to ensure the progress of manufacturing tasks smoothly in cloud manufacturing environment, an event-driven adaptive strategy have been proposed for manufacturing cloud services. For the execution of manufacturing tasks and virtual manufacturing units, events that trigger adaptive actions of manufacturing cloud services were divided into three categories of environment, manufacturing tasks and cloud services. There 19 types in detail. An event-driven manufacturing cloud service adaptive model was established. The processing algorithms of different events were given. Combined with an example, the process of event processing was described, and the model and algorithm were verified. Results show that the adaptive strategy can obviously guarantee the development of manufacturing activities in cloud manufacturing environment.

articleTitle: Image Defogging Improvement Under Non-uniform Fog Concentration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Atmospheric scattering model is the main method of image defogging. Aiming at the defects of the existing defogging algorithms in different aspects, this paper puts forward some improvement measures based on the analysis of the defects of the existing defogging methods. In view of the irrationality of estimation of atmospheric light and atmospheric scattering coefficient, a method of locating atmospheric light region based on edge extraction and a method of selecting atmospheric scattering coefficient based on fog concentration are proposed. The estimation of depth of field and transmittance is improved. Finally, adaptive contrast enhancement is carried out for foggy image. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by comparative experiments.

articleTitle: Analysis of software pricing based on binomial tree option pricing model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: A new method is designed for software pricing, which is enlightened from binomial tree option pricing model. Firstly, it is constructed about the software pricing model based on binomial tree. Secondly, computation method is shown later. Thirdly, the applicability of this computation method is demonstrated by an example. According to the calculation results, it is found out that the most two important variables are initial value of software and successful probability of every stage, which are of strong effects to the price of software. In addition, it is also concluded that value created in coding stage is usually smaller than value created in requirements stage and design stage.

articleTitle: An Industrial Control Safety Situation Assessment Based on Standard Deviation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, and the integration of informationization and industrialization, industrial control systems access the Internet in various ways, which changes the original characteristics of these systems, including closure and specialization. However, many information security issues also appear in industrial control systems. In view of the status of industrial control safety, the multi-attribution evaluation based security situation assessment on industry control has been proposed in this paper, and this approach has also been applied to the evaluation and prediction on the network security situation of China's networked power system, in order to find the potential threat information. Meanwhile, facing with the threat, some technical methods are put forward to give early warnings effectively.

articleTitle: Exploration of Topological Data Analysis In 3D Printing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This paper based on literature review introduces two powerful techniques-mapper and persistent homology in topological data analysis (TDA) to compute a topological abstraction of the printing model in 3D printing area. After leading in the theory of these methods and application of mapper for 3D printing, this paper also learns about the advantage of TDA than traditional methods for capturing the whole structure of targeted objects especially in high dimensional data. At last this paper learns about an example which combines mapper and persistent homology using dragon dataset to get evaluation of the quality of3D printed objects and reaches certain results. In conclusion, TDA in 3D printing is very potential. However, this field need to be further investigated.

articleTitle: AI-based Research and Application of Fault Diagnosis for Steam Turbine Regenerative System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: As the key equipment of electric power plant, the safe operation of steam turbine plays a vital role in practical production. At the same time, the normal and stable operation of excitation system, water-oxygen cooling system, regenerative system and other set system also play a decisive role in the safe operation of the unit. Fault diagnosis in the past mainly relied on the domain experts to judge the type of fault based on its experience, which has too much limitation, it is difficult to make effective diagnosis for the unconspicuous fault. The paper analyzed the common failures of the steam turbine regenerative system and established a typical fault set of the regenerative system. On the basis of using the fuzzy rules to establish knowledge base of fault symptom of regenerative system, a fault diagnosis method of regenerative system based on support vector machine multi-classification algorithm was proposed. Finally, the method was applied to the fault diagnosis of the regenerative system of a steam turbine. The experimental results showed that the model could effectively identify the fault of the regenerative system.

articleTitle: Research on lift characteristics of flapping-wing miniature aircraft
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to explore the lift mechanism of the flapping-wing miniature aircraft, this paper uses the special wind tunnel of Northwestern Polytechnical University to study the effects of flapping wing frequency, wind speed, angle of attack, and flapping wing camber on its lift characteristics. And using an oscilloscope is used to study the relationship between the flapping phase angle of the flapping wing and the amount of lift generated. The test results show that the study of lift characteristics provides certain engineering guidance for the overall design and aerodynamic layout design of the flapping-wing miniature aircraft.

articleTitle: Research on Large-scale Ship Data Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the development of various technologies, ship systems have become more and more intelligent. The amount of data collected has also grown exponentially. Automatic ship identification systems have become popular. The large amount of data generated by satellites and base stations has put tremendous pressure on the ship data storage system. Distributed storage is widely used in all walks of life as a storage method with large capacity and high fault tolerance. A large amount of data in the shipping field cannot be managed and shared uniformly, and there is a large amount of data accumulation and waste. This article is based on the characteristics of the industry such as high writing volume of ship data and fast query. We propose a distributed storage management method for ship big data based on HDFS. Experiments prove that this method has the characteristics of high reliability, fast read and write speed, and support for large-scale data storage and query.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation for nonlinear sloppy model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Mathematical models are very powerful tool to understand real system. For technical reasons, some parameters in models can’t be measured directly, and they have to be identified with the help of optimization algorithm. Due to the nonlinear and sloppy property of models, some algorithms fail to find a good solution even if it takes a long time. In this paper, Bregman regularization homotopy algorithm with geodesic acceleration is proposed to solve the problem. Here, Bregman regularization term is used to suppress ill-posed in inverse problem. Then homotopy plays the role of adjusting or controlling optimization convergence. And geodesic path points out the accelerate direction of the optimization process. At last polymorphnuclear leukocyte metabolic network is used to check the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Mobile App Third-Party Library traffic discovery method based on short text classification and clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Third-party libraries are used more and more in mobile applications, and their threats to mobile application security and privacy are increasing. Therefore, the identification of third-party library traffic is becoming more and more important for network security. The work on third-party libraries mainly focuses on the identification of third-party libraries and their security analysis. At present, there is very little work directly related to the identification of third-party library traffic. Based on the semi-supervised identification method of mobile application traffic based on short text classification and clustering, this paper proposes a third-party library traffic identification method using the information inside the cluster generated after clustering. Experimental results show that this method has a good effect on the identification of third-party library traffic.

articleTitle: A Jointly optimized Predictive-Adaptive Partitioned Block Transform for High Efficiency Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: High Efficiency Video Coding (HEVC) is the next generation video coding standard which has significant coding efficiency improvement compare to H.264/AVC. Interpolation Filter is the key technique to achieve high performance in video coding. In this paper, we propose a jointly optimized predictive-adaptive partitioned block transform (EDST) to exploit the spatial characteristics of HEVC and improve video coding performance.

articleTitle: Construction of Safety Management System of Student Canteen Based on HACCP
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: With the increasing number of students year by year, the school has become a high incidence of food poisoning. In order to standardize the school canteen health and safety supervision and management, prevent food poisoning and other food safety accidents, and ensure the food safety of teachers and students, this paper puts forward the construction of HACCP system suitable for student canteen. The survey data shows that the implementation of HACCP system is of great help to improve the health and safety management level of student canteens.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Performance Cryptographic Service Framework Based on TrustZone
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Due to its favorable isolation and security features, TrustZone technology has been widely used in mobile payment, cloud computing, Internet of Things, etc. However, the cryptographic algorithm provided by the trusted execution environment such as Open-TEE and OP-TEE is inadequate, which brings inconvenience to the development of trusted applications. In addition, the system mainly uses the software algorithms to provide cryptographic services and does not make full use of hardware cryptographic resources, which results in the low efficiency of cryptographic service. To Figure out these two issues, aiming at features of domestic Phytium processors, this paper establishes a unified cryptographic service framework in the TrustZone platform to build a more rich and complete cryptographic algorithm library. Meanwhile, it makes full use of the hardware cryptographic resources of the processor platform to improve the performance of cryptographic service. Test result shows that the proposed framework can bring significant convenience to the development of trusted applications. Meanwhile, compared with the original cryptographic service performance, the cryptographic service provided by the new framework can achieve significant performance improvement.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Similarities and Differences of Valve Cooling Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Since the domestic valve cooling system and valve cooling system equipment are quite different in terms of structural configuration, control and protection logic, the operation methods are also quite different. In the pole control system, the ambient temperature used for overload capacity calculation depends on the maximum value of the ambient temperature measured by the two-valve groups. When the valve group converter transformer is not charged, the default ambient temperature of the valve group is 2°C. When the valve group converter transformer is charged (the valve group is unlocked or locked), the valve group will use the measured ambient temperature to participate in the ambient temperature calculation of the maximum value. Therefore, the ambient temperature at which any valve group sends pole control will affect the overload capacity of the pole.

articleTitle: Construction of Modern Information Education Platform Based on Embedded Resource Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of modern information education, this paper puts forward the construction model of modern information education platform based on embedded resource scheduling. The overall design description and functional modularization analysis of modern information education platform are carried out. The bus automatic monitoring design of bus control program control method of modern information education platform is carried out, and the underlying database is established. The system design includes modern information education resource retrieval module, modern information education digital information resource integration processing module, bus control module, resource information fusion module, output interface control module, etc., Big data mining of modern information education is carried out, the identification model of digital information fusion of modern information education is constructed, and the software development and design of modern information education platform are realized by combining the digital integration algorithm and resource scheduling design of modern information education, and the integrated design of modern information education platform is realized under MVB bus control protocol and embedded environment. The simulation results show that the designed modern information education platform has good intelligence and strong control ability of information output, which improves the level of modern information education and management.

articleTitle: Study on the dynamic behavior of truncation errors in non-hyperbolic fixed points chaotic systems
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: It is always thought that discrete dynamical systems were collapsed from complicated long period to simple short period by computer truncation errors. In this paper, a system induced to complication completely by computer truncation is offered. The theoretical solution is a convergent sequence and the corresponding computer solution is a diverging system. Analysis shows that it's the computer truncation error that makes the system performance changes. This anti-degradation mechanism can be applied to chaotic encryption, which will solve the weak key problem caused by the collapse of chaotic system.

articleTitle: Detection of vehicle pressure line based on machine learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Intelligent transportation system (ITS) has been considered by scientists as the most effective way to solve the current urban transportation problems, and is also the mainstream direction of current and future transportation development. The premise of ITS is to obtain real-time traffic information, such as traffic flow. In this paper, we study the statistical method of traffic flow based on video detection technology in ITS. By analyzing the sample images, we obtain the basic characteristics of the video image of the moving vehicle, and select the image preprocessing method for this. At the same time, detect and extract the background of the moving vehicle video. According to the characteristics of the double yellow line area in the urban road image, the texture of the double yellow line area is increased by machine learning with the deformed Sobel operator, and the rough position of the double yellow line area in the image is segmented to obtain the accurate position of the double yellow line area. The change in the number of pixels in the virtual coil is counted to determine whether a vehicle is passing and whether the line is pressed, and the traffic flow and total traffic of each lane are counted respectively, and the vehicle type is determined by the length of time the vehicle passes through the virtual coil. It provides an effective solution to solve the current urban traffic problems, and can more accurately and effectively obtain real-time information on traffic roads.

articleTitle: A signal recovery algorithm based on linear programming
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The non-uniqueness of non-stationary signals is a difficult problem in the restoration of communication signals. We propose a piecewise smooth signal restoration algorithm based on linear programming. By constructing a total smooth bounded variation model of piecewise smooth signal restoration, the optimization process of the non-differentiable constraint problem is transformed into a nonlinear programming problem with constraints, and the complexity of solving the variation parameter is reduced. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is better than the traditional Wiener and Richardson-Lucy restoration methods in signal restoration. In the case of low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), the algorithm can also reflect the basic information of the original signal.

articleTitle: GPU-Accelerated Multipath Clutter Cancellation Algorithm for DTMB-Based Passive Radar
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to extract the target echo in the monitoring channel, the direct wave and the clutter should be suppressed in the signal processing of the passive radar. The batch version of the Extensive Cancellation Algorithm (ECA-B) is an effective time-domain clutter cancellation algorithm that can suppress direct waves and multipath clutter. And it has better robustness than ECA. However, ECA-B is a computationally intensive algorithm. Therefore, the Graphic Processing Unit (GPU) accelerated ECA-B algorithm has been studied and implemented on GPU by exploring the parallelism of the ECA-B algorithm. The paper contains the description of the algorithm implementation and the performance results analysis of the measured data.

articleTitle: An improved mobile prediction routing algorithm for Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc network is a temporary network autonomous system supporting multi hop, which is composed of a group of mobile nodes with wireless transceiver. With the growth of network application scale, it is an important research topic to support mobile prediction and improve Qos optimization algorithm in mobile ad hoc network. Based on MAODV, an optimization algorithm of Qos active route discovery mechanism and maintenance mechanism based on mobile prediction is proposed. The simulation results show that the optimization algorithm can reduce the routing overhead and improve the success rate of data transmission.

articleTitle: Space-based optical system sensor scheduling based on joint optimization of tracking performance and detection probability
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the special background of continuous tracking of mid-range targets by space-based optical sensor networks, by analyzing the essential characteristics of mid-range target continuous tracking, we proposed a space-based optical sensor scheduling model to optimize target detection and tracking performance jointly. Specifically we employed the real-valued particle swarm optimization algorithm to find the optimal solution. To demonstrate the superiority of our model, we compared our results with GDOP model, which only considers the tracking accuracy. The comparative results show that the tracking accuracy of the proposed model is comparable to the GDOP model. However, the detection probability of our model is significantly improved, which demonstrates that our model can achieve superior detection accuracy while maintaining good tracking performance.

articleTitle: A Design Method of Reusable Test Case Based on Exploratory Testing for E-Commerce Website
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Reusing of test case can reduce the workload of test design and test execution. The research is based on the concept of exploratory testing, and taking the “shopping cart” module of an e-commerce website as an example, this study is devoted to the designing of a feasible method of reusable test case based on exploratory testing and describes the reuse process. Test result shows more than reuse rate of 25% for test case can be achieved and more bugs for functionality and usability are founded through the execution of reusable test cases based on exploratory testing. Finally, further work of development of a reusable test case system based on B/S, and the technology of data mining on extraction and storage of reusable test cases are put forward in the paper.

articleTitle: Implementation of parallel algorithm for automatic seam tracking system of petroleum steel pipe
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The article presents a parallel processing method instead of traditional serial processing method used in the software of petroleum pipe welding seam tracking system. Firstly, it analyses the shortages of serial processing method, and then a parallel processing method is raised, at last, the software's working process is provided which uses parallel processing method. It is confirmed that this method saves data processing time and makes the whole system have good real time capability in practical project.

articleTitle: Development of a Flexible-receptor Docking Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Molecular docking is a key tool in computer-aided drug design. It aims to predict a binding mode of a ligand with a receptor known three-dimensional structure. The challenging but interesting areas are receptor flexibility and score functions. A novel flexible-receptor docking model has been introduced to demonstrate macromolecule flexibility. And a new score function made up of different interaction factors is established to evaluate the binding affinity. Combined with the aforementioned molecular flexibility description and score function, a new molecular docking software has been developed. An adaptive multi-generation evolutionary algorithm is adopted to solve the optimization problem. Results show that the method can give more robust and reasonable conformation in molecular docking.

articleTitle: Risk Analysis of Domestic Valve Cooling System and Equipment of UHV DC
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: This research relies on the valve cooling system of Converter Station UHV DC. The valve cooling system is based on the on-site operation and maintenance perspective, combined with the project acceptance, commissioning and research operation stages of experience accumulation, using the valve cooling system complete secondary wiring drawings, relevant equipment data and valve cooling control and protection system software on the haoprdware platform, the technical characteristics of valve cooling system structure circuit and control and protection system are comprehensively compared and analyzed. The risk identification of possible dangerous points in the operation and maintenance process is carried out, so as to find out the potential safety hazards, and formulate corresponding risk control measures, rectification suggestions, and operation and maintenance technical solutions.

articleTitle: The algorithm of robot landing point planning based on multi-constraint objective function
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of autonomous motion of robot in complex environment, this paper puts forward a robot footfall point planning algorithm based on multi-constraint objective function. The selected object is foot-type robot. Firstly, on the basis of terrain environment image acquisition, the vector representation of concavity and inclination of terrain features at the contact point is given by using quadratic function fitting method. Secondly, for the given leg length size, the space of single foot accessibility is solved, and the robot walking stability judgment algorithm based on static stability margin is given. Finally, on this basis, the optimal foot drop algorithm is proposed. The results of simulation experiments show that the algorithm proposed in this paper can ensure that the robot has a foothold that meets stability and safety during walking.

articleTitle: Research on spectrum prediction technology of BP neural network based on genetic algorithm optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: In order to use the electromagnetic spectrum more reasonably and effectively, and make users use the spectrum access more effectively, this paper first introduces the basic process and the basic elements of genetic algorithm. Because genetic algorithm is a multiple iterative search algorithm, it optimizes BP neural network, and uses those individuals with better adaptability through selection, crossover, mutation and other operations, that is, to optimize and select the optimal weight and threshold of BP neural network, improve the accuracy of spectrum prediction, reduce prediction error, and verify the effectiveness of the algorithm through simulation.

articleTitle: Improved convex set projection algorithm for Image sequence reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The convex set projection (POCS) algorithm based on set theory has the advantages of flexible observation model, simple implementation principle and easy introduction of prior information of images. It has become an important method to solve the problem of super-resolution reconstruction of sequence images. In this paper, the projection reconstruction algorithm of convex set is studied in detail. In view of the shortcomings of traditional POCS algorithm, a series of improvements are made: the weight function is constructed at the edge pixels of the image to eliminate the edge ringing effect in POCS reconstruction image; the iterative step size of relaxation projection operator is adaptively selected to improve the image restoration quality and improve the computational efficiency. The experimental results show that the improved POCS algorithm can obtain better reconstruction effect.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Path Planning Method Based on Tangent Intersection Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Aiming at the path planning problem of robots in complex field environment, this paper proposes a new method of local path planning-tangent intersection method, and the selected object is a foot robot. Firstly, the environmental information is described by constructing a new obstacle expression model; secondly, a visual tangent is constructed on this model to form an intersection network; finally, an evaluation function is used to construct a safe passage with minimum cost from the intersection network, and the simulation experiment results show that the use of the robot moving path planned by the method has high efficiency and good safety.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Detection of Nonlinear DCS Sensor of Aero-engine Based on T-S Fuzzy Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The aero-engine distributed control system has the advantages of light weight, strong scalability, and high reliability. It will be the future development direction of the engine control system. Sensor failure detection is of great significance for the safe and reliable operation of the distributed control system. This paper studies the problem of sensor fault detection for aero-engine nonlinear distributed control system based on T-S fuzzy model. Based on the division of the flight envelope, a T-S fuzzy model of the distributed control system in a certain working state is established, and the unknown time delay is converted into the generalized fault vector of the system. On this basis, the T-S fuzzy observer is designed, the linear matrix inequality is derived by means of the regional stability conditions of the error system and the requirement of the robustness index, and the correctness and effectiveness of the model are verified by an example.

articleTitle: A PyQt5-based GUI For Operational Verification Of Wave Forcasting System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: Operational statistical verification of numerical wave forecast is an important part of improving the accuracy of numerical model. We design and implement an open source verification GUI which has the characteristics of openness, sharing and freedom. Model developer can avoid making wheels repeatedly, and can quickly build a verification system with the least manpower, material and financial resources on the basis of open source software, besides, customization is also flexible. Through the strength of the NWP community, the downstream users and developers can catch systematic defects and optimize wave model based on metrics and results of verification.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based on High-Dimensional Tensor for COVID-19 Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Information Science, Parallel and Distributed Systems (ISPDS)
abstract: The breakout and rapid spread of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) has become a global health concern. The disease has infected more than 18.7 million people and caused more than 707,000 deaths all over the world, as of August 6 in 2020. Computed tomography (CT) is promising to provide screening and testing for COVTD-19.
